anime_multiverse.skill.devil_magic.descr: Ultimate. Given by a devil contract and gone when it ends. Modes: the Devil's Art (a cone of your devil's attribute: damage, its effect on the foes, a push or a pull) and the Double Art (the same art with what your own grimoire magic does on a hit added to it).
anime_multiverse.skill.devil_bond.descri: Intrinsic. The body of your devil contract, given with it and gone when it ends. Modes: Assimilate (let the devil in or push it back: horns, wings and at 100 percent the Devil Union) and Bond (read your devil, its rank, the level and the corruption of the price). The attacks are the Ultimate skill Devil Magic.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.devil.no_grim: The double art needs your own grimoire magic as well.
